Config.Name: Toolbar Info
Config.Value:
Once upon a time, in a land not so far away, HCA purchased a tool called Vergence to provide Single Sign-On (SSO) for thick-client and web applications.
Vergence came with a handy little feature called Launchpad, which quickly became a favorite among clinicians. It served as a one-stop shop for launching applications from both Single User and GenShare devices. No more hunting around for applications—Launchpad had their backs!
Fast forward a few years, and HCA decided to move from Vergence to OneSign, which eventually evolved into EAM. But there was one catch: clinicians had grown quite attached to their beloved Launchpad. So, HCA made it a requirement that Launchpad functionality move along with the new SSO solution. After all, you can't just take away someone's favorite shortcut!
And that brings us to the HCA Toolbar an in-house developed replacement for Launchpad, designed to carry forward the same convenience and functionality.
New name, new home, same mission: keeping clinicians just a click away from their applications!
